issues.display_title: Issue #78: Key equipment: show DSLR, 360 Camera, Drone in a fixed order
issues.main_description_html:
Description

On the photographer profile (e.g. /photographer/david-ramsey-35), the Key equipment list shows the groups in a random order, currently "Drone, 360 Camera, DSLR". It should be DSLR, then 360 Camera, then Drone.

Cause: the Go backend groups equipment in a Go map (getPhotographerDetailBySlug.go), and Go iterates maps in random order. Five uncached calls to /v1/photographers/david-ramsey-35 returned two different orders. The response is cached in Redis for 24h, so whichever order was cached stays on the page until it expires.

The fix lives in the frontend: sort the groups before rendering, so the page stops depending on the backend's order.

Requirements

  1. Key equipment groups render in the order: DSLR → 360 Camera → Drone → 3D Scanner → Software.
  2. A group name the frontend doesn't know goes last and does not break the page.
  3. The directory card's tools row (getPhotographerTools) uses the same group order.

Acceptance criteria

  • /photographer/david-ramsey-35 shows Key equipment as DSLR, 360 Camera, Drone, on every reload.
  • A profile with 3D Scanner or Software shows those groups after Drone.
  • Directory cards list tools in the same group order.

Out of scope

The backend map ordering (detail and /equipment endpoints) is left as is; other API consumers still get a random order.

issues.display_title: Issue #81: Directory counters: hero, results badge and list show the same total
issues.main_description_html:
Description

On a country page such as /virtual-tour-services-united-states, the counters disagree with each other and with the list:

  • Hero "32 Photographers" comes from GET /v1/photographers/count, which counts map markers (agency sublocations included, one photographer can count twice).
  • Country dropdown "United States (31)" counts distinct photographers, sublocations included.
  • Badge "13 results" is list.length: the 12 cards on the current page plus the image-processing users. Those users are added to page 1 of every directory page without a country filter, so muhamad-rifky-od6o (no country) shows up on the United States page.
  • The list itself holds 30 photographers.

Backend GoThruMedia/gothru-maps-backend-go#112 makes /v2/photographers/users return the real total and aligns the dropdown counts. GoThruMedia/gothru-maps-backend-go#111 fixes page 2 of filtered lists, which is empty today.

Requirements

  1. Hero "Photographers" uses total from /v2/photographers/users (same filters as the list) instead of /v1/photographers/count, on /, country pages and city pages.
  2. The results badge shows that same total, not the page length.
  3. Image-processing users are not added to country or city pages. The unfiltered / keeps them.
  4. The About page's photographer count uses the same source, so the site never shows two numbers for one thing.

Acceptance criteria

  • /virtual-tour-services-united-states: hero 31, badge 31, dropdown "United States (31)", and paging through yields 31 cards. Agencies appear on the pages of their sublocations too (GoThruMedia/gothru-maps-backend-go#112).
  • No image-processing card on a country or city page. / still shows them.
  • / hero equals the unfiltered total.

Depends on GoThruMedia/gothru-maps-backend-go#111 and GoThruMedia/gothru-maps-backend-go#112.
